summary: The FP4-CSF contract loader reads DeepSeek's MXFP4-CSF containers: model family from the top-level model_type, slab scales in their segment shape
details: DeepSeek's multimodal config.json names the model at the top (deepseek_v41) and its text tower in text_config (deepseek_v41_text). The CSF contract reader looked at text_config first and stopped with "CSF config must name a supported model family"; it now prefers the top-level model_type and falls back to text_config.

The reader handed a projection's slab scales to the B12X source as a flat tensor, which its validation rejected with "CSF components require matching contiguous geometry, device and dtypes"; they are now shaped as one segment of 16-row groups, as the encoding defines. Both faults stopped DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash FP4-CSF checkpoints presented in the Hugging Face layout at startup.
